text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track……
Super Creek, renowned for her exceptional stamina, was uncharacteristically out of breath from running laps.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you for checking on me~. The weather's so nice, I think I just got a bit warm.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, .
Ehehe, I feel strength welling up inside me~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to send your Umamusume
a wonderful cheer of your own, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my.
You really are quite attentive~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right. Here, take this as a token of my gratitude♪
I received homemade cookies from Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here are some special carrot cookies. Please enjoy them during your break.
